note: Adapted from the species-level description no. 157 in Chhotani (1997), The Fauna of India, Isoptera; original in English; soldier and worker based on type material; nymph absent. Synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers, distribution records and wing-venation micro-ornamentation omitted; the upper limit of fore-wing length (given in the original OCR as "7 70") and the eye–ocellus distance (given as "O.08-0.l0") are not recorded.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, much longer than wide; mandibles falcate, stout and short, with a larger tooth on the basal third of the inner margin; postmentum bottle-shaped, waist at the posterior third. Alate head capsule slightly wider than long; antennae 14-segmented; fore wing including wing scale up to 7.30 mm long. Worker dimorphic; compound eyes as small brown spots.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule and postclypeus pale golden brown to dark golden brown; antennae, labrum, thorax and legs pale golden yellow; mandibles dark reddish brown; abdomen pale yellow. Head and pronotum densely pilose, abdomen and legs moderately pilose. Body length 6.20–6.30 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, much longer than wide (1.70–1.76 mm to mandible bases, maximum width 0.98–1.08 mm). Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest, segment 4 about as long as segment 2. Postclypeus pilose, separated from the frons by a semicircular boundary; anteclypeus hyaline, bare, band-like. Labrum subpentagonal, with a median apical process, sparsely pilose (length 0.25–0.28 mm, width 0.33–0.34 mm). Mandibles falcate, stout and short (length 0.90–0.95 mm); inner margin finely serrate, with a larger tooth at the basal third; slightly more than half the head length without mandibles (mandible length to head length ratio 0.53–0.54). Postmentum bottle-shaped, waist at the posterior third (length 1.0–1.08 mm, maximum width 0.30–0.35 mm, waist width 0.20–0.23 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin without a notch or with a feeble median notch; posterior margin nearly straight, without an incision (length 0.38–0.42 mm, width 0.62–0.63 mm). Mesonotum nearly as wide as or slightly wider than the pronotum; metanotum wider than the pronotum.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule, antennae, labrum and postclypeus pale yellow; thorax, legs and abdomen pale yellow. Head and body moderately pilose. Body length about 4.5–5.30 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, posterior margin rounded (0.90–0.98 mm to mandible bases, maximum width 0.93–0.95 mm). Fontanelle indistinct. Compound eyes as small brown spots. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus convex, pilose; about half as long as wide; separated from the frons by a semicircular boundary. Anteclypeus hyaline, bare, projecting forward at the middle of the anterior margin. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin slightly concave, posterior margin nearly straight (length 0.33–0.34 mm, width 0.60–0.63 mm). Minor worker: similar to the major worker but smaller, body length 4.2–4.6 mm, head length to mandible bases 0.73–0.78 mm, maximum head width 0.80–0.83 mm, pronotum length 0.23–0.26 mm, maximum width 0.45–0.50 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark yellowish brown; postclypeus and pronotum pale yellowish brown; antennae and thorax lighter; anteclypeus and legs pale yellow; wings pale yellowish brown; abdominal tergites pale brown. Head densely pilose, body densely pilose. Body length with wings 9.0–10.6 mm, without wings 5.7–6.8 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, slightly wider than long (0.80–0.88 mm to mandible bases, width including compound eyes 0.90–0.97 mm). Fontanelle minute but distinct, situated on the middle of the vertex. Compound eyes subcircular (maximum diameter 0.25–0.26 mm, minimum diameter 0.22–0.23 mm), separated from the lower margin of the head by about half their diameter. Ocelli semitransparent, subspherical (maximum diameter 0.06–0.09 mm, minimum diameter 0.05–0.07 mm), separated from the compound eyes by about their long diameter. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 shortest, about half of segment 2. Postclypeus convex, sparsely pilose; about half as long as wide (length 0.23–0.27 mm, width 0.50–0.53 mm); posterior margin rounded, anterior margin nearly straight. Anteclypeus hyaline, bare, projecting forward at the middle. Labrum domed, wider than long (length 0.18–0.23 mm, width 0.33–0.40 mm). Pronotum subtrapezoidal, wider than long (length 0.45–0.46 mm, width 0.60–0.68 mm); anterior margin nearly straight, without a median notch; posterior margin slightly concave. Mesonotal posterior margin deeply concave. Wings long, pilose, with tubercles; fore wing including wing scale 7.30 mm long, hind wing 6.80–7.00 mm long; fore wing with 15–16 branches of the cubital vein, hind wing with 14.
